name: @meowshed/meow-go
description: Detects Go from the modules git tracks, reports each module's language version, pinned toolchain, declared tools and golangci-lint configuration, prints a stages table bound from them with the race detector on in test, reports a golangci-lint configuration that is not the version 2 shape and states a supply-chain check's reach, and compares the pinned toolchain with the installed one, writing no file, and carries what a reviewer of Go checks that no command reports. Distributed as a Pi package.
